info.name: Harmonic MediaGrid MG-API (Storage Monitoring)
info.description: REST endpoints extracted from a captured HAR trace of the Harmonic MediaGrid management dashboard at 10.204.131.250. All endpoints are read-only GET calls returning cluster health/storage/bandwidth JSON. Session appears to be cookie-authenticated in the browser (no Authorization header was present in the capture) — set the `sessionCookie` variable if you need to replay against a live device. Saved example responses are the FULL bodies captured in the HAR (not truncated).

request.description: Top-level summary per cluster: available/maximum diskspace, bandwidth thresholds, client and content-director counts.
Per-cluster list of Content Director nodes: firmware version, IPs, checkpoint status, model/serial number, service status.
Per-cluster list of content server/store nodes (CSS/CSJ types): available/max diskspace, controller status, slice server status.
Per-cluster physical drive inventory: drive GUID/model/status, enclosure, RAID set name/type/status, slot number. Full captured payload (~125KB, hundreds of drives).
Per-cluster top-5 largest directories by storage size, with path and last-updated timestamp.

Time-series used diskspace per cluster between startTime and endTime, plus warning/critical storage thresholds. If startTime/endTime are omitted, returns a longer historical series (observed ~30 min interval samples).
Time-series read/write/replication bandwidth per cluster, plus warning/critical bandwidth thresholds.
Per-cluster, per-Content-Director RPC workload metrics: file read/create/delete/status counts, directory reads, commit status.
